intro: From April to July 2026, ZCyberNews published seven articles under Check Point Research, covering four high-severity and two critical-severity vulnerabilities. The most prominent threat actor observed was Handala Hack, alongside Silver Dragon and The Gentlemen. Key CVEs included CVE-2024-55591, CVE-2025-32433, and CVE-2025-33073. The research impacted sectors such as government, business services, consumer, critical infrastructure, and mobile, with affected regions spanning China, Europe, Global, Israel, and Mexico.
